projections.interpretation: Unconstrained synthetic capacity forecast, not permission to exceed admission. Phase 4 polling/diversity assumptions retained; no new measured polling slopes.

hypothesis.interpretation: Synthetic results verify mechanics only. No accuracy gain or prospective evidence is established.

limitations: No automatic prospective eligibility; chronological dates alone are insufficient.
Week and league bootstrap intervals are separate descriptive sensitivity checks, not complete multiway dependence inference.
No historical ordered-engine-input replay, independent training artifact or new untouched holdout is established.
Caller JSON cannot establish provenance; use the private integrity-checked database export.
